scope: Decision record following user questions about base model, attention efficiency and Gaussian scene memory; proposals are untested unless marked measured.

baseline_choice.decision: Retain LingBot2 14B causal-fast as current generator while testing memory integration.
baseline_choice.evidence: Current PlayWorld table reports LingBot2 1.82, LingBot1 1.78, HY-World2 1.61 and Matrix3 1.14. Hosted score does not establish local checkpoint parity.
baseline_choice.alternative: Released LingBot2 1.3B could accelerate algorithm screening, but needs its own baseline and transfer validation; its quality cannot be assumed equal.

runtime.measured: Existing H200 profile already executes aten::_flash_attention_forward: 37.63% exclusive GPU operator time. SDPA is not unfused quadratic-matrix attention.
runtime.pending: Dedicated runtime subagent is testing temporary memory lifetimes and a newer fused kernel on an isolated image.
runtime.claim_limit: A faster attention kernel does not change the semantics of geometric memory.

observed_memory_failure.measured: Eight-view variants at an18-frame attention budget produced discontinuities and were not preferred over four nearest views.
observed_memory_failure.interpretation: This confounds number of historical views with loss of recent context. It does not establish that eight historical views are inherently harmful.
observed_memory_failure.next_control: Compare22-frame4-view and22-frame8-view memory, preserving at least8 recent/current frames, with same pose selection and denoising. Rerun18-frame4-view control after lifetime optimization.

gaussian_design.hypothesis: A persistent spatial map can stabilize static layout and provide visibility-aware conditioning, while recent video supplies dynamic evolution.
gaussian_design.not_sufficient: A Gaussian renderer alone supplies appearance and geometry, not dynamics, action transitions or reliable unseen surfaces. Fusing inconsistent generated frames can preserve contradictions.
proposed_pipeline: Estimate depth and realized camera poses from a small past-only keyframe set; compare pose/depth reprojection rather than treating commanded poses as measurements.
Keep separate local submaps with confidence, source timestamps and update provenance; mask moving or inconsistent regions.
Render visible geometry or latent features plus coverage/confidence at the requested camera.
Condition the pretrained generator through a trained adapter or use the map only to route existing historical KV; keep recent video context available.
Fine-tune only adapter parameters on separately sourced camera-consistent clips, with corrupted-history examples; retain the frozen generator baseline.
gaussian_design.decision_gate: Before training a geometric adapter, show that reconstruction from early generated keyframes explains held-out adjacent frames and a revisit better than a view-only retrieval baseline. Reject low-confidence map writes and report rejected coverage.
gaussian_design.evaluation: Complete agent-driven leave/return episodes plus dynamic visible/hidden events. Show landmark identity, route continuity, map confidence and held-out failures. A static splat-only tour cannot validate dynamic evolution.

research_references.name: VMem
research_references.relevance: Surfels index historical views by visible surface overlap; useful lower-cost geometry routing baseline.

research_references.name: LSM-World

research_references.relevance: Persistent latent spatial cache and adapter recipe; not the same backbone or checkpoint as our LingBot2.

research_references.name: WorldTrace
research_references.relevance: Keep recent verbatim frames and bounded addressable history; preserve positional meaning.

research_references.name: WorldKV
research_references.relevance: Pose/action-indexed native KV retrieval and redundancy compression.

attention_options_not_yet_tested: Maintain a protected recent window while expanding historical context.
Spatially select historical tokens by visibility, rather than loading complete near-duplicate frames.
Separate recent/history attention with an explicit confidence gate; requires validation or adapter training, not assumed compatible zero-shot.
Compress redundant history while preserving positional addressability.
coverage_limit: Targeted review of35 papers with selected method/result/limitation checks. Not every paper read in full and no claim of exhausting all tricks.
